title: Each effect becomes the DAW's matching stock device, in the order written
description:
As a producer, I want each effect in the score to become the DAW's matching stock device, in the order written, so that I can tweak the mix with the DAW's own controls.

```gherkin
Feature: Effects become stock devices
  Scenario Outline: One effect, one device
    Given the track "a" has the effect "<effect>"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the track "a" has the device "<device>"
    And the device is set to <settings>
    Examples:
      | effect                                              | device      | settings                                                           |
      | eq lowcut 120 low -3@250 peak -4@800 q1.4 highcut 9k | EQ Eight    | a low cut at 120 Hz, a -3 dB low shelf at 250 Hz, a -4 dB bell at 800 Hz with Q 1.4, a high cut at 9 kHz |
      | comp 4:1 -18dB attack 10ms release 120ms mix 50%    | Compressor  | ratio 4, threshold -18 dB, attack 10 ms, release 120 ms, dry/wet 50% |
      | limit -1dB release 50ms                              | Limiter     | ceiling -1 dB, release 50 ms                                       |
      | drive 12dB tone 3k                                   | Saturator   | drive 12 dB with its tone as close to 3 kHz as it allows           |
      | lofi bits 8 rate 11k                                 | Redux       | 8 bits, 11 kHz                                                     |
      | noisegate -40dB attack 1ms release 80ms              | Gate        | threshold -40 dB, attack 1 ms, release 80 ms                       |
      | width 150%                                           | Utility     | width 150%                                                         |
      | reverb hall 2.4s predelay 20ms damp 35% mix 30%      | Reverb      | decay 2.4 s, predelay 20 ms, damping as decided, dry/wet 30%       |
      | delay 1/8. feedback 35% hp 400 lp 4k pingpong mix 30% | Delay      | synced to a dotted eighth, feedback 35%, filter 400 Hz to 4 kHz, ping pong, dry/wet 30% |
      | delay 350ms                                          | Delay       | unsynced at 350 ms                                                 |

  Scenario: Effects keep their order
    Given the track "a" has the effects "comp 4:1 -18dB", "eq lowcut 120" and "reverb plate 1.6s"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the devices of "a" are "Compressor", "EQ Eight", "Reverb" in that order

  Scenario: A track filter comes first
    Given the track "a" has "filter lp 800" and the effect "comp 4:1 -18dB"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the devices of "a" are "Auto Filter", "Compressor"
    And the Auto Filter is a 12 dB low-pass at 800 Hz

  Scenario: A return's effects are all wet
    Given the return track "plate" has "reverb plate 1.8s" with no mix given
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the Reverb on "plate" is at 100% dry/wet
```

Note: the device names are the DAW's stock device names; the exact parameter conversions (and the device chosen for `drive`) are fixed in `design/daw-set.md` (M0).
